product: TTE All-33-Estate GPU Crop Forecasting Upgrade
scope: Current-practice crop forecasting for all 33 estates
selection_rule: Lowest chronological validation WAPE among GPU, CPU and seasonal candidates
prompt_actual_policy: Use completed estate/day actuals strictly before today
short_history_policy: Eildon Hall and Tillicoultry remain pooled provisional

known_local_inputs.tri_weather: Select the TRI-Thalawakele base/update workbook(s) in the launcher

notes: Actual crop does not require model training.
Best-practice forecasting requires validated GAP, field, fertilizer, foliar and sundry-work evidence.
GPU candidates are not selected unless they beat controls on chronological validation.
All outputs remain in a timestamped candidate folder until separately approved.
The launcher validates all 33 ZIPs before preparing weather caches and temporarily prevents Windows sleep.
One PROMPT actual-data snapshot is frozen at batch start so all 33 estates share the same cutoff.
Windows PowerShell keep-awake flags use explicit unsigned hexadecimal conversion.
